description: This Java source file defines a specialized exception class `ConnectionUriInvalidException` used in the Eclipse Ditto project. The exception indicates that a Connection object was configured with an invalid URI. It includes constructors, builders, and related methods for creating exception instances, along with associated metadata such as error codes and message templates.
